Minors (A.R.S. § 23-233): Arizona's night limits (9:30 p.m. before a school day, 11 p.m. otherwise, from 6 a.m.) are looser than federal 7 a.m.-7 p.m. (9 p.m. summer); federal.json still applies to FLSA-covered employers. No Arizona hour limits for 16-17.

rules.summary: Arizona's basic minimum wage is $15.15 an hour (DOL table, Nov. 2026).

citation.title: US DOL WHD — State Minimum Wage Laws (updated Nov. 5, 2026)

rules.summary: Minors under 16 enrolled in school may work at most 3 hours on a school day, 8 on a non-school day and 18 hours in a school week, not between 9:30 p.m. and 6 a.m. before a school day (11 p.m. before a non-school day).

citation.title: A.R.S. § 23-233 — Permissible hours of labor for persons under sixteen
citation.excerpt: Not more than eighteen hours in any one week when the person is enrolled in any session of school when school is in session ... Not more than three hours in any one day

rules.summary: When school is not in session, minors under 16 may work at most 8 hours a day and 40 hours a week, not between 11 p.m. and 6 a.m. before a non-school day.

citation.title: A.R.S. § 23-233 — Permissible hours of labor for persons under sixteen
citation.excerpt: Not more than forty hours in any one week when ... school is not in session ... Not more than eight hours in any one day when ... school is not in session

rules.summary: Arizona employers may pay tipped employees up to $3.00 less than the $15.15 minimum wage (cash wage $12.15) if wages plus tips reach the minimum.

citation.title: A.R.S. § 23-363(C) — Minimum wage, tipped employees
citation.excerpt: For any employee who customarily and regularly receives tips or gratuities ... the employer may pay a wage up to $3.00 per hour less than the minimum wage
